title: Fix ESLint errors: remove unnecessary escape characters in phone regex
body:
CI failing due to `no-useless-escape` lint errors in phone validation regex at `validation-engine.ts:174`.

## Changes

- **Fixed regex**: Characters `+()` don't require escaping within character class
  ```diff
  - const phoneRegex = /^[\d\s\-\+\(\)]+$/;
  + const phoneRegex = /^[\d\s\-+()]+$/;
  ```

- **Added test coverage**: Phone validation now tested with common formats (`123-456-7890`, `+1 (234) 567-8900`, `1234567890`)

## Note

The regex remains intentionally permissive (allows any combination of digits, spaces, `-+()`) - this is pre-existing behavior, not modified by this PR.
